site: Ras El Ma / Ras Kebdana, Morocco
vertical_reference: Local hydrographic zero of the Port of Ras Kebdana (survey-plan cartouche)
important_scope: One observation per 30 m HLS pixel; spatial calibration and testing use distinct buffered alongshore zones. Scores are site-specific and do not establish cross-site transfer or absolute-depth agreement between different port datums.
measurement_note: Errors are against the site's aggregated survey z values. The site-local vertical reference is not tied to the other study site's port datum.
